newsitem.title: EU: Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 28 - Sunday, Aug 3.
newsitem.headline: Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 28 - Sunday, Aug 3.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS

LUXEMBOURG - European Commission DG VI Director Laurent Van Depoele holds n/conf on farm and rural development issues in Agenda 2000 and the EU's strategy and actions in politics as of the year 2000 (Mon).
BRUSSELS - European Commission regular weekly meeting (Wed).
AUGUST - EU institutions closed for summer holidays.
MONDAY, JULY 28

LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission DG VI Director Laurent Van Depoele holds n/conf on farm and rural development issues in Agenda 2000 and the EU's strategy and actions in politics as of the year 2000 (1600/1400 GMT). Venue: European Commission representation, Kirchberg.

KUALA LUMPUR - ASEAN and 10 dialogue partners, including European Union "troika" countries - Britain, Luxembourg and the Netherlands - and European Commission, hold post-ministerial meeting (and Tues).
TUESDAY, JULY 29
No events scheduled.
WEDNESDAY, JULY 30
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission regular weekly meeting (0900/0700 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Community anti-dumping policy.
- Commission directive on the prevention of Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (TSE) transmissible via medicines.
- Commission decision banning material presenting risks relating to TSEs.
- Modification of decision clearing accounts presented by the member states on EAGGF-guarantee expenses for 1993-1996.
- Proposal for Council establishing a convention on admission regulations for third world citizens in European Union member states.
- Commission opinion on a European Investment Bank (EIB) loan.
- Creation of a Task Force for the simplification of the administrative environment for SMEs.
- Outcome and future of the audiovisual policy.
- Electronic payment methods.
THURSDAY, JULY 31

EDINBURGH - Scottish Financial Enterprise holds conference on "Finance and entrepreneurship" (0900/0700 GMT). Speakers include European Commission Enterprise Policy Directorate-General (DG XXIII) official Stephen Ryan. Venue: Edinburgh international conference centre. Contact: In Conference (44) 131 556 9245.
AUGUST
- EU institutions closed for summer holidays.
